lexical_ablation.input: URL/title/element text/event action and target replaced by placeholders; only trace length/structure remained
lexical_ablation.interpretation: The synthetic benchmark contains strong lexical/template shortcuts. The raw 100% score must not be treated as real-user intent accuracy.
Removing lexical content leaves the released decider unable to recover the synthetic intent labels; this is a shortcut diagnostic, not a real-user failure rate.

decision: Expand human/session labels and add paraphrase, cross-domain, ambiguous-title and counterfactual traces before making a deployment claim.
